fetter.title: Swirling Snow
fetter.detail: A famed Snezhnayan ballerina who blossoms against the frozen landscape with a beauty as sharp as frost.

costume.name: Snow Swan's Dance
costume.description: Odette's outfit. A ballet outfit of exceptional make, inspired by the snow swans, that has served as the diligent ballerina's faithful companion across countless long nights. The gems that adorn it glisten with a quiet elegance beneath the stage lights, just like the shimmering dancer herself.

nameCard.name: Odette: The Singular Swan
nameCard.description: Namecard style.\nWhether in Liyue or Snezhnaya, swans are universally seen as majestic, haughty creatures. Yet there lives a lone black swan among the gregarious snow ones. Well, at least that's how the story goes in the "Black Snow Swan."

0.name: Snow Swan Variation
0.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Unleashes a sword attack of up to 5 consecutive strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash a dazzling slash on opponents in front of her.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Attacks opponents in her path while plunging from mid-air, then deals AoE DMG upon landing.

1.name: Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers
1.description:
With slow, graceful dance steps, Odette deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to the opponent, and also summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} to the field.
If a <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette is already on the field, this will re-summon the Dance Double and reset its duration.

<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>
Alternates between the <color=#FFD780FF>Plume</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Wing</color> dance moves, periodically attacking nearby opponents and dealing to them <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will become the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK} instead, where a dance duet deals <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> to nearby opponents over time. Then, when the duet ends, she deals another instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl DMG.

3.name: Presto: Bluebird Finale
3.description:
With quick, lively dance steps, Odette deals multiple instances of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>, and summons her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11500001}Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}. She also gains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, which increases the Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG Odette deals.
Additionally, for 6s after unleashing the Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color>, Odette's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> will be replaced with the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}{LINK#N11500004}{/LINK} instead.

If there is a Solo Dance Double summoned by Odette on the field, it will be summoned to her side with its duration refreshed.

4.name: Spring Rite of the Chosen One
4.description: When Odette summons her {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK}, she also obtains 4 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}.

5.name: Pathetique of Pateticheskaya
5.description: For every 100 ATK Odette has over 1,000, her Stellar Glimmer DMG is additionally increased by 1.5% of the original DMG. She can deal up to 30% more additional DMG in this way.

6.name: Stellar Jubilee: Dance of Aurore
6.description: Odette will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state when she is inside a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}, or the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> state for 8s after a nearby party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction.\nWhen a party member triggers a Superconduct or Cryo Swirl reaction, it becomes a Stellar-Conduct or Stellar Swirl reaction instead, and the Base DMG of said reaction is also increased by 0.7% for every 100 points of Odette's ATK. A maximum increase of 14% can be obtained in this way.

8.name: Echo of Winter Daydreams
8.description: Shows the locations of <color=#FFD780FF>Snezhnaya's Local Specialties</color> on the mini-map, and this effect also applies in the Shadow Realm.\nPracticing dance in one's spare time might even trigger other effects...

0.name: "On This Danceless Morn, She Gazes at Her Reflection"
0.description:
After unleashing the special Elemental Skill {LINK#N11500002}<color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>{/LINK}, at the dance duet's end Odette will deal an additional instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo AoE DMG</color> to nearby opponents that is considered:
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 300% of Odette's ATK;
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 450% of Odette's ATK.

Additionally, the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is also enhanced: now, when the {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} is summoned, Odette also gains 2 stacks of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK}. When Odette is off-field, the rate at which <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> is removed is sped up to 2 stacks per second.

1.name: "I Must See the Snow Swan's Unseen Dream for Myself, She Thought"
1.description:
The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: every stack of {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} active also increases the character's ATK by 7%.
Additionally, if Odette is in the {LINK#N11500004}<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>{/LINK} state when there is a {LINK#N11500001}<color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>{/LINK} on the field, opponents near the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> will also have their corresponding Elemental RES lowered by 20%.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color>.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: <color=#99FFFFFF>Cryo</color> and <color=#80FFD7FF>Anemo</color>.

2.name: "I'll Chase the Shouting Wind Along, Climbing Alone As I Go"
2.description: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11502}Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

3.name: "Up, Up the Long, Delirious, Burning Blue"
3.description:
The Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>Presto: Bluebird Finale</color> is enhanced as follows: when Odette obtains <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan's Dream</color>, Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by other nearby party members is increased by 50% of <color=#FFD780FF>Snow Swan Dream</color>'s effects.

Additionally, when a party member deals Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG to an opponent, Odette will also join in with a coordinated attack, dealing an instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>. This effect, which can trigger once every 3.5s, will be considered:
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> or when not in a Radiance state: Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG at 66% of Odette's ATK.
·<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color>: Stellar Swirl reaction DMG at 99% of Odette's ATK.

4.name: "Oh! I Have Slipped the Surly Bonds of Earth"
4.description: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11505}Presto: Bluebird Finale{/LINK} </color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

5.name: "Put Out My Hand, and Touched the Face of the Divine"
5.description: The Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One" is enhanced as follows: When Odette grants {LINK#N11500003}<color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color>{/LINK} to all nearby party members, her own Marvelous Splendor stacks will no longer decrease.\nAdditionally, characters affected by <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> have their Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt to opponents {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%, and Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by Odette is elevated by an additional 20%.

N11500001.name: Solo Dance Double
N11500001.description:
A psychic double of Odette's that dances a duet with her. May be summoned to the field through her Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst.
Alternates between the <color=#FFD780FF>Plume</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Wing</color> dance moves to periodically attack nearby opponents, dealing <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color>.
A maximum of one <color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette is allowed on the field at any one time.

Additionally, when there is a <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> summoned by Odette nearby, her Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Phantom Night Dancers</color> is changed to the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>.

N11500002.name: Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling
N11500002.description:
Odette's special Elemental Skill, which deals to nearby opponents <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> over time. Then, when the dance duet ends, she deals another instance of <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> that is considered Stellar-Conduct DMG. During the dance duet, Odette can control the direction of the dance steps.
<color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color>: The DMG dealt when the dance duet ends is changed to <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> of the corresponding Stellar reaction type.

Additionally, after Odette unleashes the special Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>Adagio: Coda at Dawn's Tolling</color>, should she be in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> state while her <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> is still on the field, the <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color>'s two dance moves types will also deal additional <color=#99FFFFFF>AoE Cryo DMG</color> of the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction type.

N11500004.name: Radiance: Stellar Glimmer
N11500004.description: <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Swirl</color> are both considered <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar Glimmer</color> states.\nCharacters can only be affected by one Radiance state at any one time, and where more than one state can be triggered, <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> shall apply first.

N11500003.name: Marvelous Splendor
N11500003.description: After unlocking the Ascension Talent "Spring Rite of the Chosen One," Odette will obtain a special effect when she summons her <color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color>.\nEvery stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> active increases the character's Stellar Glimmer DMG by 15%. This lasts until her <color=#FFD780FF>Dance Double</color> exits the field or when she summons her <color=#FFD780FF>Solo Dance Double</color> again.\nWhen Odette is off-field, she loses 1 stack of <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> every 1 second, while other nearby party members gain the corresponding number of <color=#FFD780FF>Marvelous Splendor</color> stacks at the same time.

N11330003.name: Polestar Field
N11330003.description: When Stellar-Conduct is triggered, the surrounding area will transform into a <color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color> for a short period of time, and when inside a Polestar Field, certain characters will enter the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state, which grants various skill buffs.

N11190007.name: Elevation
N11190007.description: Special DMG Boost effect. It is calculated independently of other DMG Boost effects.
